 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+The test suite runs with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/):
+
+```sh
+pip install pytest
+python -m pytest
+```
+
+Run a single file or test with the usual pytest selectors:
+
+```sh
+python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py
+python -m pytest test_pricing_cache.py::test_lookup_falls_back_to_snapshot
+```
